latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Lecture Maker — Initial Release

- Create narrated lecture videos from slides, scripts, or video files (PDF, PPTX, MP4, MOV, up to 500MB).
- Instantly generate AI voiceovers and export 1080p MP4 lecture videos in minutes.
- No need for manual recording or on-camera presence—ideal for educators and course creators.
- Simple cloud workflow: upload, describe what you want, and download when ready.
- Supports checking credits, exporting, and tracking session status via user-friendly commands.
